tours.name: Archive a Time Off Type
tours.description: Learn how to archive a time off type that is no longer used, so employees can no longer request it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to archive a time off type that is no longer used, so employees can no longer request it.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: Time off types are managed in the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: Time off types are managed in the Time Off app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists used by the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists used by the Time Off app.

steps.title: Time Off Types
steps.description: Each type is a kind of leave that employees can request, such as Paid Time Off or Sick Time Off.

description_i18n.en_US: Each type is a kind of leave that employees can request, such as Paid Time Off or Sick Time Off.

steps.title: Find the time off type
steps.content: Type the name of the time off type and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the time off type and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

steps.title: Select it
steps.content: Tick the box in front of the time off type.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in front of the time off type.

steps.description: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to archive them together.

description_i18n.en_US: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to archive them together.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

steps.title: Archive
steps.description: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

description_i18n.en_US: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

steps.description: Odoo asks once more because the change affects every ticked record.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo asks once more because the change affects every ticked record.
